title: Environmental DNA storage and extraction method affects detectability for multiple aquatic invasive species
author: García, Samantha
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Store filters in ethanol
steps.instruction: Place each collected filter into a tube containing 95% ethanol (EtOH) for storage before DNA extraction with the Qiagen kit.

steps.title: Store filters in CTAB
steps.instruction: Place each collected filter into a tube containing cetyl trimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) for storage before DNA extraction with the PCI method.

steps.title: Extract DNA from ethanol‑stored filters
steps.instruction: Use the DNeasy PowerSoil Pro Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol to extract DNA from filters stored in 95% ethanol.

steps.title: Extract DNA from CTAB‑stored filters
steps.instruction: Perform a phenol–chloroform–isoamyl (PCI) extraction on filters stored in CTAB following standard PCI procedures.

steps.title: Set up qPCR (1 µL extract)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of each DNA extract to the qPCR reaction mix for detection of the target invasive species.

steps.title: Set up qPCR (3 µL extract)
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL of each DNA extract to the qPCR reaction mix for detection of the target invasive species.
